svg.title: The Appearance tile in Q and the Appearance sheet
svg.desc: Four screens: Q with the new fixed Appearance tile last, the Appearance sheet with Standard selected, the sheet with custom colors, and the sheet while Night Mode is on.
svg.text: Appearance: the tile in Q, and the sheet it opens (issue 138)
One new fixed tile, last in Q. It is a button: it closes Q and opens the sheet. Q's tiles are not edited, reordered or swiped.
Each theme in the sheet is drawn in its own two colors, so the list reads the same whatever colors the app has now.
A. Q, with Appearance last
Fourteen tiles in full auto, still
five rows. The tile shows the
theme's name. Tapping it closes Q
and opens the sheet.

g.text: Themes change nope.'s colors only. Your photos are
not changed. Night Mode keeps its own colors.

svg.text: B. The sheet, Standard selected
A tap applies a theme at once.
Selection is a check mark, an
outline and the selected trait,
never color alone.

g.text: Themes change nope.'s colors only. Your photos are
not changed. Night Mode keeps its own colors.

svg.text: C. Custom colors
Two system color pickers. Choosing
a color selects Custom. Custom
colors are not checked and carry
no note.

g.text: Night Mode is on. The theme you choose shows
Themes change nope.'s colors only. Your photos are
not changed. Night Mode keeps its own colors.

svg.text: D. With Night Mode on
Night Mode is unchanged: red on
black. The sheet says the theme
shows when Night Mode is off.
